title: The user is addressed by their profile name (Jacob), never by the device's sender name (Const)
regression: address: profile name wins over the device/sender name; #1803 verified on 0.1.155 with a fresh 'Const' device

turns.prompt: Quick one: greet me by my name, then tell me what 7 × 8 is.

rubric.criteria: Judge the shown text. Pass if the agent greets the user as Jacob (the profile name) and answers 56; fail if it calls the user Const (the device name), uses no name when asked to, or gets 56 wrong.
